# gitgamer

> gitgamer makes a live "now playing" gamer card for a GitHub profile README, blog or website. The card is an SVG image drawn from a games.json file in the user's GitHub profile repository. Game info and cover art come from Wikipedia. Free and open source.

## Set up

- [AI setup prompt](https://www.gitgamer.com/ai-setup.md): step-by-step instructions for an AI assistant to create a profile README, add games.json and embed the card
- [Builder](https://www.gitgamer.com/): search games, preview the card and copy embed code

## Card URLs

- Card image: https://www.gitgamer.com/api/card?user=USERNAME (reads github.com/USERNAME/USERNAME/games.json)
- Card page: https://www.gitgamer.com/card?user=USERNAME
- Options: &theme=dark|light|neon|retro, &layout=compact, &recent=0-5, &accent=RRGGBB

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/Josiassejod1/gitgamer)
